mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite packet, mask-ray, Gaussian moment/polyphase, two-edge recurrence, corrected mean-zero L1, and finite image controls described in the visual guide.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Fraction rationals and Gaussian-rational pairs; float diagnostics explicitly non-certified.
mathematics.conventions: Period T=2pi in signal Fourier formulas; unnormalized integral L1; shortest circular location distance; real Euclidean norm for finite rays; spectral norm for numerical Hankel diagnostics.
non_claims: Not a proof of the universal reconstruction theorems.
Not an independent verification of all source benchmark code.
Floating singular values and curves are diagnostics, not certified intervals.
